nodes.description: Brainz.tokenIdToTimestamp: mapping(uint => uint) storing the last reward-claim timestamp per staked Bit Monster.
Brainz.rng: private Rng struct holding the pseudo-random state used by the stake game.
ERC20._balances: mapping(address => uint256) of BRAINZ balances.
ERC20._totalSupply: total BRAINZ supply.
ERC20._allowances: nested allowance mapping.
Ownable._owner: privileged owner address.
BitMonstersAddon.bitMonsters: external IBitMonsters contract reference set by the owner.
RngLibrary.newRng(): creates an Rng seeded from getEntropy().
RngLibrary.getEntropy(): keccak256(block.coinbase, msg.sender) - not a secure entropy source.
RngLibrary.generate(Rng): advances the Rng state and returns a uint256.
RngLibrary.generate(Rng,min,max): bounded pseudo-random number in [min,max].
Ownable.constructor: sets the deployer as owner.
Ownable.owner(): returns the current owner.
Ownable.onlyOwner modifier: restricts callers to the owner.
Ownable.renounceOwnership(): sets owner to address(0).
Ownable.transferOwnership(address): changes the owner.
Ownable._setOwner(address): internal owner update and event.
BitMonstersAddon.onlyAdmin modifier: requires bitMonsters.isAdmin(msg.sender).
BitMonstersAddon.ownsToken modifier: requires bitMonsters.ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender.
BitMonstersAddon.setBitMonstersContract(): owner sets the BitMonsters contract address.
ERC20.constructor(string,string): sets name and symbol.
ERC20.transfer(address,uint256): public transfer.
ERC20.approve(address,uint256): sets allowance.
ERC20.transferFrom(address,address,uint256): allowance-based transfer.
ERC20._transfer: internal balance bookkeeping.
ERC20._mint: internal mint, increases totalSupply and recipient balance.
ERC20._burn: internal burn, decreases balance and totalSupply.
ERC20._approve: internal allowance write.
ERC20.increaseAllowance(address,uint256).
ERC20.decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).
ERC20Burnable.burn(uint256): destroys caller tokens.
ERC20Burnable.burnFrom(address,uint256): allowance-based burn.
Brainz.constructor: ERC20('Brainz','BRAINZ') plus initial Rng state.
Brainz.adminMint(address,uint256): admin-gated minting of count * 1 ether.
Brainz.adminBurn(address,uint256): admin-gated burning of count * 1 ether.
Brainz.claimBrainz(): loops over all owned Bit Monsters, credits rewards and mints the total.
Brainz.rewardRate(BitMonster): pure reward multiplier calculation.
Brainz.calculateRewards(uint): days-based pending reward calculation.
Brainz.register(uint): admin stakes a token by recording block.timestamp.
Brainz.stake(uint): 50/50 coin-flip game driven by the pseudo RNG.
msg.sender: untrusted caller address.
block.timestamp: miner/validator-influenced time source.
External-call loop over bitMonsters in claimBrainz performed before the final _mint (reentrancy surface).
Predictable randomness in Brainz.stake - outcome derived from block.coinbase/msg.sender and can be precomputed or biased.
Timestamp arithmetic (block.timestamp - tokenIdToTimestamp) driving reward amounts.
Arithmetic mint of the accumulated reward total in claimBrainz.
Arithmetic computation of the stake payout ((count - count/10) * 1 ether).
Arithmetic scaling of admin mint/burn amounts by 1 ether.
count parameter of Brainz.stake: amount of BRAINZ to wager.
rn local in Brainz.stake: memory snapshot of the rng state.
won local in Brainz.stake: outcome flag returned to the caller.
tokenId parameter of Brainz.register.
tokenId parameter of Brainz.calculateRewards.
nDays local in Brainz.calculateRewards: elapsed days derived from block.timestamp.
total local in Brainz.claimBrainz: accumulated rewards to mint.
count local in Brainz.claimBrainz: number of owned Bit Monsters.
addr parameter of Brainz.adminMint.
count parameter of Brainz.adminMint.
newOwner parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership.
delta local in RngLibrary.generate(min,max): max - min.
min parameter of RngLibrary.generate(min,max).
max parameter of RngLibrary.generate(min,max).

edges.reason: msg.sender is validated by the onlyAdmin modifier before adminMint executes.
msg.sender is validated by the onlyAdmin modifier before adminBurn executes.
msg.sender is validated by the onlyAdmin modifier before register executes.
msg.sender is forwarded to bitMonsters.isAdmin for the admin check.
msg.sender must equal bitMonsters.ownerOf(tokenId) in the ownsToken modifier.
msg.sender determines which tokens are enumerated and who receives the minted rewards.
msg.sender is the staker whose balance is checked and who receives the payout.
burn destroys the tokens of msg.sender.
burnFrom consumes the allowance granted by msg.sender.
transfer moves tokens out of msg.sender's balance.
msg.sender is hashed into the entropy value used by the RNG.
Pending reward days are computed directly from block.timestamp.
claimBrainz floors the last claim time to a 86400 boundary using block.timestamp.
register stores block.timestamp as the staking start time.
block.timestamp is subtracted in the reward arithmetic.
newRng seeds the Rng struct from getEntropy().
generate pulls fresh entropy when advancing the RNG state.
bounded generate delegates to the unbounded generate.
Ownable constructor sets the initial owner via _setOwner.
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner(address(0)).
transferOwnership calls _setOwner with the new address.
onlyOwner compares owner() against _msgSender().
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
burn calls the internal _burn.
burnFrom calls the internal _burn.
burnFrom reduces the spender allowance via _approve.
transfer calls the internal _transfer.
approve calls the internal _approve.
transferFrom calls the internal _transfer.
transferFrom rewrites the allowance via _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the allowance.
decreaseAllowance writes the allowance.
Brainz constructor invokes the ERC20 constructor.
The rng state variable is initialised with RngLibrary.newRng().
adminMint is guarded by onlyAdmin.
adminBurn is guarded by onlyAdmin.
register is guarded by onlyAdmin.
adminBurn calls the internal _burn.
claimBrainz calculates the rewards of every enumerated token.
claimBrainz mints the accumulated total to msg.sender.
claimBrainz reads balances and token ids from the external bitMonsters contract.
claimBrainz rewrites tokenIdToTimestamp after a successful reward calculation.
calculateRewards reads the BitMonster traits from bitMonsters.
calculateRewards multiplies the day count by rewardRate.
calculateRewards reads the last claim timestamp of the token.
The stake outcome comes from the pseudo-random generate(0,1) call.
stake reads the rng state into memory and writes it back afterwards.
stake mints the payout when the RNG returns 0.
stake burns the entire wager when the RNG returns 1.
_mint increases totalSupply.
_mint increases the recipient balance.
_burn decreases totalSupply.
_burn decreases the account balance.
_transfer updates the balances mapping.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
The owner can point bitMonsters at an arbitrary contract address.
onlyAdmin queries bitMonsters.isAdmin for authorization.
ownsToken queries bitMonsters.ownerOf for ownership authorization.
claimBrainz performs external calls in a loop before the final mint.
bitMonsters is an external contract whose calls can re-enter the Brainz contract.
A malicious bitMonsters implementation can call back into claimBrainz before the mint completes.
The stake result is derived from predictable pseudo randomness that can be precomputed and biased.
The reward amount depends on block.timestamp arithmetic.
The accumulated reward total is minted without any upper bound check.
The payout is computed as (count - count/10) * 1 ether and minted.
adminMint scales the user supplied count by 1 ether.
adminBurn scales the user supplied count by 1 ether.
The count parameter drives the stake balance check and payout arithmetic.
The rn local holds the rng snapshot used and written back by stake.
The won local reports the game outcome.
The tokenId parameter identifies the token being registered.
The tokenId parameter selects the Bit Monster whose rewards are computed.
nDays is the timestamp-derived day count feeding the reward arithmetic.
total is the accumulated amount that gets minted.
count bounds the enumeration loop over owned Bit Monsters.
The addr parameter receives the minted tokens.
The count parameter is scaled by 1 ether before minting.
The newOwner parameter becomes the new owner address.
delta = max - min is used as the bounded range size.
The min parameter bounds the generated random value.
The max parameter bounds the generated random value.

normalization_plan.reason: count is a parameter of Brainz.stake and only influences that function's wager amount.
rn is a local memory copy of the rng state used only inside Brainz.stake.
won is the return local of Brainz.stake and carries no standalone semantics.
tokenId is a parameter consumed only by Brainz.register.
tokenId is a parameter consumed only by Brainz.calculateRewards.
nDays is the local produced by the block.timestamp arithmetic unsafe operation.
total is the local accumulation that is minted by the claimBrainz mint unsafe operation.
count is a local loop bound used only inside Brainz.claimBrainz.
addr is a parameter of Brainz.adminMint that only selects the mint recipient.
count is a parameter of Brainz.adminMint that only determines the minted amount.
newOwner is a parameter consumed only by Ownable.transferOwnership.
delta is a local of RngLibrary.generate(min,max) that only holds the range size.
min is a parameter of RngLibrary.generate(min,max) with no standalone effect.
max is a parameter of RngLibrary.generate(min,max) with no standalone effect.
